notes: New name: That Ain't Living Barry!
Online server with accounts - log in on the menu with your website account
Fresh menus, a cartoon logo and a What's New list
Customise your character: silly hats, funny shirts and slightly-too-big shoes
Minimap shows everyone (players and bots); click the map button for the full island
Steeper country to explore - roll your ute onto its side or roof and crawl out
R recovers and flips your ute for everyone, and fixes a rolled tyre
Proximity voice chat: hold V to talk to people nearby
Chat window (Enter) with separate Players and Bots tabs
Wave at people (Y), kick a beach soccer ball around
Health bar hidden - get skittled five times and the ambos still come
Ask your helper to nudge you out from the helper buttons
Dingoes on Fraser, ute bonks, and the earlier fun stuff
